title: Exact constant and pullback interface for strict completed-coefficient towers
statement: For an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], use the canonical coefficient identifications and exact module pullback F of [def-weil-pbc-four-corners]. The constant strict tower functor is exact; its induced derived functor is left adjoint to completed Rlim [def-pur-completed-rlim-functor]. The normalized reduction augmentation [def-weil-pbc-reduction-augmentation] defines the quotient completion unit by composition with this adjunction unit. Whiskering right with F applies F to every level and transition of a strict tower and preserves finite limits and colimits. Its exact induced derived functor commutes with constant towers via the comparison induced by identity component maps. No identification with intrinsic completion is required.

proof.text: Keep the existing constant and Rlim constructions and apply the exact/right-derived adjunction theorem. Compose its unit with Rlim of the normalized reduction augmentation.

Exactness of ringed module pullback follows from the canonical coefficient isomorphism. Whiskering right preserves finite limits and colimits pointwise. Apply the exact derived-functor construction, and derive the componentwise identity constant-tower comparison.
